author: Ortea, Moro & Espinosa, 1998

note.en: A tiny sea slug (nudibranch) of the genus Doto that feeds on hydroids. Known from survey samples at Manzanillo and west of Punta Mona, 0 to 8 m (2001 to 2002). Too small for most divers to notice.
note.es: Una babosa de mar diminuta (nudibranquio) del género Doto que se alimenta de hidroides. Conocida de muestras en Manzanillo y al oeste de Punta Mona, 0 a 8 m (2001 a 2002). Demasiado pequeña para que la noten la mayoría de los buzos.

evidence: GBIF: survey records at Manzanillo and Punta Mona (1999 to 2002)
WoRMS lists the Costa Rican part of the Caribbean Sea

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
